attempts.summary: Implemented sudo command logging on node1 via an Ansible playbook (local connection): a sudoers.d drop-in sets a dedicated logfile (/var/log/sudo-commands.log, root-only 0600) and disables sudo's syslog output (Defaults !syslog), so every sudo command is recorded with user, timestamp, PWD, and command, and is no longer duplicated into /var/log/auth.log. Verified functionally (auth.log COMMAND= count frozen at 6 while the dedicated log kept growing) both before and after a full node restart. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol on both node1 and node2: captured baseline boot IDs, restarted each node one at a time via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, and confirmed changed boot IDs plus recovered health/config.
